title: KoBBQ: Korean Bias Benchmark for Question Answering
findings: Bias related to religion was measured as one of 12 social bias categories. The results, presented graphically, show the diff-bias score for religion in comparison to other categories, but the paper does not provide a specific textual analysis or highlight unique findings for the religion category itself.
